notes: A.1 item 67: 'External repository information (other information beyond the required information). This item is optional. This item, if provided by the implementor, shall be documented' (8.13). cite.py --check 8.13 'any other information that the implementor requires' -> OK 8.13. PROVIDED and documented (owner decision kb/Work/R44; DESIGN-external-repository 5.4; docs/CONFORMANCE.md section 7 DOC-A.1-67): beside the 8.13 list each assembly records its repository schema version, the major version of the WiseOwl COBOL runtime it was compiled against and the compiler's call ABI, and each unit its user-defined word beside its externalized name; a compilation refuses an entry whose schema, runtime major or call ABI differs from its own (COBOL5967); nothing else beyond 8.13 is recorded or compared. Witnesses: the word recorded beside the externalized name is what lets a later compilation name a function by its word (pb2103_function_word_in_repository; REPO-13 across the repository), and the runtime major recorded is what REPO-7 / REPO-12 compare (APreviousBuildAnotherRuntimeMajorCompiled_IsRepo12_AndIsOverwritten, AGroupFunctionPrototype_IgnoresAnEntryAnotherRuntimeMajorCompiled). retired-witness: conformance-test:ExternalRepositoryResolutionTests.APreviousBuildAnOlderRuntimeCompiled_IsRepo12_AndIsOverwritten (kb/Work PB4470 renamed the method to APreviousBuildAnotherRuntimeMajorCompiled_IsRepo12_AndIsOverwritten: RuntimeVersionSkew's stale entry is another runtime MAJOR, not an older runtime; the row cites it under the new name) retired-witness: conformance-test:ExternalRepositoryResolutionTests.AGroupFunctionPrototype_IgnoresAnEntryAnOlderRuntimeCompiled (kb/Work PB4470 renamed the method to AGroupFunctionPrototype_IgnoresAnEntryAnotherRuntimeMajorCompiled: RuntimeVersionSkew's stale entry is another runtime MAJOR, not an older runtime; the row cites it under the new name)
